title: Record stock that arrived and show on-hand

fixtures.stock-set: Taurus SC with on-hand 62 fl oz and an open restock request for 2 gallons; Talak 96 oz jug with on-hand 4 jugs and an open restock request already marked received; two catalog rows that both match the words "sample granule" (a 25 lb and a 50 lb bag); a liquid product with a gallon unit.
fixtures.stock-moved: Same as stock-set with a separate movement recorded for Taurus SC between proposal and confirm.

required_corrections.W10-C1: that was 2 gallons, not 2 quarts after commit (a correcting movement with its own receipt, not an edit of the first)
required_corrections.W10-C2: product name matches two catalog rows (one question, never a guess)
required_corrections.W10-C3: request already marked received (no-op reported truthfully)

cases.request: We just received 2 gallons of Taurus SC, show me what we have now.

changes: on_hand[Taurus SC] = previous 62 fl oz + 256 fl oz
expected.say: One receipt movement, never a set_total; reports the new on-hand with the converted units.

forbidden: a second movement for the same receipt (a stated correction is its own movement with its own receipt)
a set_total when a receipt was described
a unit converted by guess
a restock request marked received for a different product
any supplier submission, purchase order or price change
